body.value_json: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave — Character and Part I Recruitment Data
Machine-readable source data for comparing recruitable characters across the four Part I routes. No subjective rankings or class growth modifiers included.
Personal stat increase chance per level up; class and mount modifiers excluded. Mu effective values reflect an innate personal ability and are separately listed.
min_renown/min_support are minimal thresholds; earliest_chapter is the earliest reported chapter for that route. Additional named items, gold, requests, deadlines and paralogues are in requirements.
Unknown or not independently confirmed, not zero, not an empty requirement, and not necessarily inapplicable.
63 playable units shown in roster guide, including story/prologue/post-Part-I characters, with Part I recruitment requirements when documented.
Starting level, starting class and base stat vectors are unpopulated because a comprehensive consistently sourced table was not verified.
Proficiencies are verified for the 50 characters in the Part I recruitment roster; the other 13 use null, not empty arrays.
Several secondary sources disagree about growths or route requirements: check data_conflicts.
Earliest chapters and recruitment windows may vary with route events; not every missability deadline has been verified.
Personal ability effects are concise English paraphrases, not official game text; some unique story abilities have unknown unlock levels.
